text:
Asha: Quick sync request: large financial customer wants BYOK for Private with operator-assisted import ONLY in DR. Key asks: two-person approval, no Redwood access to plaintext, immutable audit trail (tamper-evident), and residency + retention for 10 years. What RBAC + audit changes do we need? tagging @Jordan @Samir @Priya

Jordan: RBAC idea: attribute-based role 'importer' with constraints: allowed_actions=[ImportKey], allowed_scopes=[customer_id], require_approval=2, approval_methods=[MFA, hardware_token]. Short-lived import token issued after approvals.

Samir: Infra constraints: import pipeline must accept only wrapped blobs + PoP signed by customer KMS key. Attest operator workstation and HSM before any unwrap attempt. We SHOULD never have unwrapping key in our control plane. If import happens into Redwood-managed HSM, the unwrapping must happen inside HSM with hardware logs exported.

Priya: For audit we need signed, canonical events. Options: 1) HSM-signed event (preferred), 2) service signs event with key in HSM and logs written to WORM store (immutable). Include fields: import_proof_type, operator_id, operator_role, approval_ids, hsm_fw_version, attestation_hash.

Asha: Legal also asked about residency: customer wants EU-only storage for audit events and a CIP (chain of custody) artifact for every import. Can we scope exports per-tenant regionally?

Samir: Yes, we can tag events with tenant_region and route storage to region-local WORM buckets. Need to add a config flag 'force_region_residency' at import time.

audit-bot: audit-bot: Schema scan report: missing fields required by compliance: 'approval_ids', 'attestation_hash', 'hsm_fw_version', 'tenant_region'. Created ticket SEC-2234 to extend schema + backfill last 180 days.

Jordan: API sketch (very small):
```
POST /v1/kms/import 
body: {wrapped_blob, pop_signature, metadata:{tenant_id, region, purpose}} 
response: {key_id, import_event_id} 
```
Approval flow: approvals must be recorded as separate signed events with approver_id + method.

Priya: Retention: default 7 years for audit events, offer contractual 10-year option. For GDPR erase requests, we can't delete cryptographic evidence tied to legal obligations; need legal review.

legal-bot: legal-bot: Draft clause proposed: "Provider will not possess unencrypted customer keys; all import operations are performed only with customer-provided wrapped material or inside customer-managed HSMs. Provider will maintain tamper-evident audit records for a minimum of X years, stored in tenant-region unless otherwise agreed." Will refine.

ops-oncall: IR runbook notes: on suspicious import detect -> 1) revoke 'importer' tokens immediately, 2) snapshot HSM audit channel, 3) export signed import events to forensics bucket, 4) notify customer per SLA (propose 1 hour for suspected compromise), 5) engage legal. Add tabletop quarterly.

Asha: Vulnerability check: customer asked about firmware CVE exposure. We should enforce minimum hsm_fw >= 5.3.0 for imports and block otherwise with operator-visible reason. Also include auto-notify template for affected customers.

Jordan: Action items: I will open RFC for RBAC/approval UI and add schema diffs. Samir, please draft attestation flow + region routing. Priya, draft retention options and opt-in language. Legal-bot will produce initial contract text. ops-oncall prepare runbook stub and schedule drill.

Asha: Thanks everyone. If no blockers I'll merge these into the BYOK RFC next week. :thumbsup:
